reason: I would have to send our open PO lines, job material requirements and supplier history to a startup I have never heard of, and that is a data-sharing decision that goes to IT and probably the Epicor partner before it goes to me. My planners already catch the slips that matter, so I can't see spending a week of approvals and export cleanup on a free audit.
objection: Sending our supplier and job data outside the building to an early-stage company, with no Epicor login and no way for me to check what happens to it, is the thing that stops this before the value question even comes up.
would_change_my_mind: Our Epicor partner vouches for them and IT signs off on a sanitized export, and the audit can show a supplier date change on one of my open jobs that my planners had not already flagged.
